zh.title: BootBridge
zh.stepOf: 第 {n} 步 · 共 6 步
zh.s1l: 不同机型需要不同的官方固件版本。选好后，后面的下载链接和说明会自动对应。
zh.s1fine: 生成桥接包时只按文件指纹自动识别，这里的选择只用于显示对应的下载和说明。
zh.s2l: {m} 需要先升级到下面这个官方版本。可以直接下载，也可以把已下载的文件拖进来确认。
zh.dropB: 把官方固件 BIN 拖到这里
zh.dropN: 只读取文件，不会修改原件
zh.dlSrc: 来自 H3C 官方服务器，完成后自动校验
zh.okTitle: 已确认：这是 {m} 的指定固件 {v}
zh.okSub: 文件完整，可以用它升级路由器，也会在第 4 步用来生成桥接包。
zh.sameAs: 大小和 SHA-256 与指定版本一致
zh.badTitle: 这个文件不在支持列表中
zh.badSub: 可能是其他版本，或文件下载不完整。请在上方重新下载指定版本。
zh.s3t: 把路由器升级到指定版本
zh.s3l: 用刚才确认过的官方固件，在路由器自带的管理后台完成一次普通升级。
zh.s3warn: 必须先升级到 {v}。否则刷入桥接包后，维护页会显示“暂不可安装”。
s3steps: 用浏览器打开路由器的管理地址并登录。
通常在「系统设置 → 固件升级」，不同机型菜单名称可能略有不同。
上传官方固件并等待重启
选择第 2 步确认过的文件。升级期间不要断电或拔网线。
重启后在「系统状态」页查看，版本号应为 {v}。
zh.s4l: 用同一份官方固件生成桥接包。原件只读，不会被修改。
zh.genFine: 不会覆盖已有文件；输出后会再完整核验一遍。
zh.noFileP: 先在第 2 步拖入并确认官方固件，这里会自动带过来。
zh.verifying: 正在完整核验输出文件…
zh.noClose: 处理中请不要关闭窗口
zh.doneT: 桥接包已生成，完整核验通过
zh.doneS: 下一步把它上传到路由器官方后台。
zh.noUpgrade: 安装完成后，请尽量不要再升级路由器系统。
zh.s5l: 和第 3 步一样，通过官方后台的固件升级入口上传，只是这次选择桥接包。
s5steps: 再次进入固件升级页面
登录路由器管理后台，打开「固件升级」。
期间不要断电。重启后路由器会进入 BootBridge 维护模式。
把电脑接到路由器 LAN 口，电脑会自动获取 192.168.10.x 地址。
zh.s5info: 维护模式不提供上网功能，这是正常的。
zh.s6l: 最后一步在浏览器里完成。工具这里只提供指引。
s6steps: 用浏览器访问下面的地址。
备份包含设备敏感信息，请妥善保存，不要公开分享。
等待完成提示，期间不要断电。
可以在维护页选择「返回原厂系统」。
zh.s6backup: 先备份，再安装。备份是出问题时恢复的唯一依据。
zh.faqQ: 维护页显示“暂不可安装”？
zh.faqA: 最常见的原因是路由器没有先升级到 {v}。可以按下面的顺序处理：
faqSteps: 在维护页选择「返回原厂系统」
回到第 3 步，升级到指定版本
重新上传桥接包（第 5 步）
zh.offlineUpd: 工具和规则不会联网自动更新。官方固件可在第 2 步直接下载，并按指定的 SHA-256 校验。
zh.uAutoS: 启动时检查，不会自动安装
zh.uFwS: 在第 2 步直接下载并校验
zh.diagS: 出现问题时复制给开发者
zh.about:
BootBridge 桌面版 0.3.0 · 引擎 ABI v2
GPL-2.0-or-later · 以普通用户权限运行
zh.autoSwitched: 已识别为 {m} 的官方固件，已自动切换机型。
zh.readErrS: 文件可能正在被占用，或已被移动。请关闭占用它的程序后重试。
zh.pathErrT: 不支持这个位置的文件
zh.pathErrS: 请把文件复制到本地磁盘的普通文件夹（例如「下载」）后再选择。
zh.rulesBadS: 请重新下载完整的 BootBridge 压缩包，并保持 BootBridge.rules.dat 与程序在同一文件夹。
zh.noUrl: 也可以在 H3C 官网搜索「{m} {v}」手动下载。
zh.saveTitle: 保存新桥接 BIN（不会覆盖已有文件）
zh.oneFile: 一次只能选择一个文件
zh.ambiguous: 此原件对应多个不同输出方案，离线目录未提供唯一合并包，已拒绝生成。
zh.fetchNote: 这个版本没有公开下载链接。可以用路由器的 SN 向 H3C 官方查询下载地址，直接下载并校验。
zh.snLabel: 路由器 SN（机身底部标签，或管理后台「设备信息」）
zh.snPrivacy: SN 只发送给 H3C 官方服务器 magic.h3c.com，用于查询这台路由器的下载地址；BootBridge 不保存、不记录。
zh.fetchQuery: 正在向 H3C 官方查询下载地址…
zh.needSn: 请输入正确的路由器 SN（6–30 位字母、数字或 -）
zh.fetchFailHint: 未完成的下载不会留下文件。可以重试，或手动下载后拖到下方。
zh.eNet: 无法连接到 H3C 服务器。请检查网络或代理设置后重试。
zh.eTls: 无法建立安全连接。Windows 7 需要先安装更新 KB3140245（启用 TLS 1.2）；也可以手动下载。
zh.eTimeout: 连接超时，网络可能较慢或不稳定。请稍后重试。
zh.eHttp: 服务器拒绝了请求（{f}）。下载地址可能已过期，请重试。
zh.eRejected: H3C 没有为这台路由器返回下载地址（retCode {f}）。请核对 SN 是否填写正确。
zh.eOther: H3C 现在提供的是 {f}，不是本向导审核过的 {v}，因此没有下载。请等待 BootBridge 更新。
zh.eBad: 服务器的回复不符合预期格式，已停止。
zh.eUrl: 服务器给出的下载地址不在允许的官方地址范围内，已停止。
zh.eSize: 下载的大小与指定版本不一致，已丢弃。
zh.eHash: 下载内容的 SHA-256 与指定版本不一致，已丢弃。
zh.eFile: 无法写入保存位置。请换一个本地文件夹（例如「下载」）后重试。

en.title: BootBridge
en.s1l: Each model needs a specific official firmware version. Download links and instructions will follow your choice.
en.s1fine: The bridge is always matched by file fingerprint. This choice only changes which links and instructions you see.
en.s2l: {m} must first be upgraded to the version below. Download it here, or drop a file you already have to check it.
en.dropB: Drop the official firmware BIN here
en.dropN: Read-only. The original file is never modified.
en.dlSrc: From H3C's official server, verified automatically
en.okSub: The file is intact. Use it to upgrade the router; it will also be used in step 4.
en.sameAs: Size and SHA-256 match the required version
en.badSub: It may be a different version or an incomplete download. Please download the required version above.
en.s3t: Upgrade the router to the required version
en.s3l: Use the verified official file to run a normal upgrade from the router's own admin page.
en.s3warn: Upgrade to {v} first. Otherwise the maintenance page will show "Not installable" after flashing the bridge.
s3steps: Sign in to the router admin page
Open the router's admin address in a browser and sign in.
Usually under System → Firmware Upgrade. Menu names vary by model.
Upload the official file and wait
Choose the file verified in step 2. Do not power off during the upgrade.
After reboot, the status page should show {v}.
en.s4l: Build the bridge from the same official file. The original stays read-only.
en.genFine: Never overwrites existing files. The output is fully verified after writing.
en.noFileP: Drop and confirm the official file in step 2. It will carry over here.
en.doneS: Next, upload it from the router's admin page.
en.noUpgrade: After installation, avoid upgrading the router system where possible.
en.s5l: Same as step 3: use the firmware upgrade page, but choose the bridge package this time.
s5steps: Open the firmware upgrade page again
Sign in to the router admin page and open Firmware Upgrade.
Choose the bridge package and upload
Do not power off. The router restarts into BootBridge maintenance mode.
Plug the computer into a LAN port. It will receive a 192.168.10.x address.
en.s5info: Maintenance mode has no internet access. This is expected.
en.s6t: Install U-Boot on the maintenance page
en.s6l: The last step happens in your browser. This tool only guides you.
s6steps: Visit the address below in your browser.
The backup contains sensitive device data. Keep it private.
Click Install once all checks pass
Wait for completion. Do not power off.
Choose 'Return to OEM system' on the maintenance page.
en.s6backup: Back up before installing. The backup is your only way to recover.
en.faqA: Most often the router was not upgraded to {v} first. Try this:
faqSteps: Choose 'Return to OEM system' on the maintenance page
Go back to step 3 and upgrade to the required version
en.offlineUpd: The tool and its rules never update themselves online. Official firmware can be downloaded in step 2 and checked against the pinned SHA-256.
en.uAutoS: Checks at startup, never installs on its own
en.diagS: Copy and send to the developer when something goes wrong
en.about:
BootBridge Desktop 0.3.0 · Engine ABI v2
GPL-2.0-or-later · Runs with standard user rights
en.autoSwitched: Recognized as official firmware for {m}. Model switched automatically.
en.readErrS: The file may be in use or was moved. Close any program using it and try again.
en.pathErrT: Files in this location aren't supported
en.pathErrS: Copy the file to a regular local folder (such as Downloads) and choose it again.
en.rulesBadS: Re-download the complete BootBridge package and keep BootBridge.rules.dat in the same folder as the program.
en.noUrl: You can also search for "{m} {v}" on the H3C website and download it manually.
en.saveTitle: Save new bridge BIN (existing files are never overwritten)
en.oneFile: Choose one file at a time
en.ambiguous: This file maps to more than one output, and the offline catalog has no single combined package. Build refused.
en.fetchNote: This version has no public download link. BootBridge can ask H3C for the official link using your router's SN, then download and verify it.
en.snLabel: Router SN (on the label under the router, or under Device info in the admin page)
en.snPrivacy: The SN goes only to H3C's official server magic.h3c.com to look up this router's download link. BootBridge never stores or logs it.
en.fetchQuery: Asking H3C for the download link…
en.needSn: Enter the router SN (6–30 letters, digits or -)
en.fetchFailHint: An unfinished download leaves no file behind. Try again, or download it manually and drop it below.
en.eNet: Could not reach H3C's server. Check your network or proxy settings and try again.
en.eTls: Could not set up a secure connection. Windows 7 needs update KB3140245 (TLS 1.2) first, or download it manually.
en.eTimeout: The connection timed out; the network may be slow or unstable. Try again later.
en.eHttp: The server refused the request ({f}). The link may have expired; try again.
en.eRejected: H3C returned no download link for this router (retCode {f}). Check that the SN is correct.
en.eOther: H3C now offers {f}, not {v} reviewed for this guide, so nothing was downloaded. Wait for a BootBridge update.
en.eBad: The server's reply was not in the expected format, so BootBridge stopped.
en.eUrl: The server gave a download address outside the allowed official host, so BootBridge stopped.
en.eSize: The download size does not match the required version; it was discarded.
en.eHash: The download's SHA-256 does not match the required version; it was discarded.
en.eFile: Could not write to that location. Choose a local folder such as Downloads and try again.
